evidence: Modifies signing logic affecting RPC PSBT processing in `src/script/sign.cpp` and tests in `test/functional/rpc_psbt.py`; category definition notes that descriptor/PSBT changes without wallet code belong to RPC.
rationale: Fixes a correctness and privacy issue where RPC methods like `descriptorprocesspsbt` and `utxoupdatepsbt` leak unrelated MuSig2 participant pubkeys, derivation paths, and leaf hashes into PSBT fields (issue #36323). Correctness of returned data and preventing exposure of sensitive key material are top priorities in RPC.
